Operating Activities
Net cash provided by operating activities during the fiscal year ended August 31, 2024, was primarily due to non-cash expenses and net income, a decrease in inventories and an increase in accounts payable, accrued expenses, and other liabilities. Net cash provided by operating activities was partially offset by an increase in prepaid expenses and other current assets, an increase in accounts receivable and an increase in contract assets. The decrease in inventories is primarily due to higher consumption of inventory to support sales and improved working capital management. The increase in accounts payable, accrued expenses and other liabilities is primarily due to the timing of purchases and cash payments. The increase in prepaid expenses and other current assets is primarily due to the timing of payments. The increase in accounts receivable is primarily driven by the timing of collections.
